what_would_change_my_mind: A cluster of two or more officers buying in the same window.

short.rationale: Sales are pre-planned and small relative to holdings.

medium.rationale: Selling is lighter than last year's pace -- barely positive.

long.rationale: Insiders retaining large stakes is a faint vote of confidence.

comparison_class.definition: Large-cap semiconductor names with a comparable setup over the last decade
comparison_class.why_this_class: Same sector and size bucket; the base rate of a positive move is the anchor before seat-specific evidence.

key_evidence.claim: No cluster of buys present, single officer purchase only

thesis: Two sales (one routine 10b5-1, one single director sale) against one single open-market buy. None of the transactions form a cluster, and the one clean signal -- the officer buy -- is not large relative to their existing holding. This does not clear the bar for a directional call under the signal grammar; most insider activity in this window is noise.
